notes.title: Satan's Dungeon V2 Update1
notes.content: [h2][b]Changes in the new version of [i]Satan's Dungeon[/i]:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a [b]hint system [/b]and [b]new dialogues[/b] to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Chinese and Russian[/b] languages to game subtitles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redesigned the second level of the game (Maze)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed identified bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Made the game lighter and [b]more optimized[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Facilitated access to different endings[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]game UI[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]achievement system[/b][/p][/*][/list]
